supersedes.reason: v3 required a receipt to contain its own SHA-256; v4 moves the receipt digest to an external atomic sidecar

purpose: Run one model-independent sealed join to decide R06 and R07 and freeze one runtime-eligible action-space hash per BLIND circuit. Decide R13 after reseal by binding every preregistered recommendation method to those same circuit hashes.

permitted_derivations: one frozen runtime-eligible action-space hash per circuit
one_shot_protocol.executed_stage_reference_definition: Each path-backed, non-NOT_RUN HF/HMF stage-mode reference. Contract-defined NOT_RUN and repeatability NO_RESULT_PATH rows are excluded.
one_shot_protocol.consumption_order: Immediately before the first BLIND data read, atomically create the irreversible CONSUMED marker with exclusive-create semantics. Any crash after marker creation consumes the only attempt.
one_shot_protocol.atomic_release: After the marker exists, keep all candidate-level state in memory; write one final aggregate JSON only after all three circuits complete, then write receipt.json.sha256 as an external sidecar.
one_shot_protocol.failure_action: Because the marker already exists, write one outcome-free failed envelope with no per-circuit partial values and its external SHA-256 sidecar; immediately reseal and do not retry.

allowed_receipt.aggregation: one atomic receipt with one row per BLIND circuit; recommendation methods do not appear in the unseal receipt

R07.pass_when: For every BLIND circuit, missing_runtime_join_count == 0, ambiguous_runtime_join_count == 0, unique_runtime_join_count == executed_stage_reference_count, and coverage_rate == 1.0.

R13.pass_when: After reseal, data/manifests/blind_runtime_method_binding_v1.json binds every method in the preregistered method registry to the exact per-circuit hashes from the atomic receipt, with no method-specific exclusion.

decision_rules.p0: P0 remains BLOCKED until an independent assessment establishes every R01 through R14 as PASS.
